description: Attack edges between command concepts. Used by the minimal Phase-27 argumentation gate (BLOCK_ACTION defeats every PositionCommand on the same target) and by the Phase-31 ASPIC+ evaluator (preference-resolved grounded extension over all attack edges). See VIZA_INVESTMENT_COMMAND_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §2.7.

conflicts.rationale: System veto. A BLOCK_ACTION on a target means PIT/rights/validation/live-mode preconditions failed and no position command may stand.
Strategy-level exclusion contradicts increasing long exposure.
Exit and increase cannot both stand for the same long position.
Exit and entry cannot both stand for the same target at the same cutoff.
Reducing and increasing the same position contradict.
